Explanation:  
The question asks which president featured on a U.S. coin in 1972 served the longest as President of the United States. The ground truth answer is Franklin Delano Roosevelt (served 12 years). The predicted answer claims Dwight D. Eisenhower (featured on the 1972 Eisenhower dollar) served from 1953 to 1961 (8 years). Eisenhower did not serve the longest; Roosevelt did. Also, although Eisenhower was on the 1972 dollar coin, he did not serve longer than Roosevelt. The predicted answer does not contain the information from the ground truth answer.

Decision: FALSE
